title: API: history search returns only matches, no total; the other location's entry has changedAtWorkplaceName
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-B1 is stocked at Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge; note its part id at each location and its description. Before the run, at Staging Heavy Duty deactivate QAPL-B1 in bulk with the note "Superseded by RC-500X", then activate it again with no note. API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com: Network tab, right-click a captured request > Copy as fetch, edit method/URL/body in the Console; header X-Location-ID = the current location's id.
custom_steps:
1. GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-B1 Heavy Duty id> (X-Location-ID = Staging Heavy Duty).
  2. GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-B1 Heavy Duty id>?search=superseded, then ?search=SUPERSEDED.
  3. In the app at Staging Heavy Duty, open QAPL-B1, add " QA" to the end of its Description and click Save.
  4. Open QAPL-B1's Part History at Staging Heavy Duty.
  5. GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-B1 Lethbridge id> with X-Location-ID = Staging Lethbridge; then switch the app to Staging Lethbridge and open QAPL-B1's Part History.
  6. At Staging Heavy Duty, set QAPL-B1's Description back to the original and click Save.
custom_expected:
1. 200; the entries include the deactivation with note "Superseded by RC-500X" and the later activation with note null.
  2. 200 both times; only the entries whose text or staff name contains "superseded" are returned (the deactivation with the note), not the activation or other entries; the response carries no total count.
  3. Before saving, "This also changes the description at 1 other location." shows under the field; the part saves.
  4. The newest entry reads "Description updated | Original description: {old} | New description: {new}" with no "| Changed at:" (the change was made here).
  5. 200; the newest "Description updated" entry has changedAtWorkplaceName "Staging Heavy Duty" and changedThrough null. On screen the entry ends "| Changed at: Staging Heavy Duty".
  6. Saved; the description is restored at both locations.
